response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software engineer with 13+ years of professional work, but the resume shows essentially no overlap with the core requirements of a Principal Performance Architect role in AI accelerator silicon. There is no evidence of SoC or IP modeling, RTL/architectural simulation, hardware-software co-design, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, or deep neural network training/inference optimization. The closest adjacent experience is low-latency service work in DLang at Sociomantic and some C/C++ component work at National Instruments — application-level performance, not microarchitecture. Education is a BS in Computer Science (meets the 8+ years path formally) but without the domain specialization the role demands. This is a fundamental domain mismatch rather than a seniority gap.
strengths: 13+ years of broad software engineering across web, mobile, desktop, and some embedded work
Demonstrated low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of req/sec, async I/O, fibers) in DLang
Strong engineering-culture signal: OSS projects, test tooling, conference talks, and workshops
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, RTL, or hardware architecture experience whatsoever
No AI/deep-learning workload, GPU, or SIMD/MIMD accelerator background
Career trajectory is application/full-stack, not principal-level silicon performance architecture

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and hardware co-design experience
No AI accelerator / DNN workload optimization background
Senior-level systems and low-latency performance engineering
